description: Source code for an API documentation parser class 'ApiParser' that reads markdown files, extracts class/method/parameter info, and constructs documentation objects.

classes.name: ApiParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing markdown API documentation files, extracting class and member definitions, and building structured documentation data.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads markdown files from a directory, and processes them into class and member definitions.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a class definition node from markdown and adds it to the internal class map.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses a class member (method, event, property) node from markdown and adds it to the corresponding class.

methods.name: parseArgument
methods.description: Parses a parameter or option node associated with a method or class.

methods.name: parseProperty
methods.description: Parses a property type definition from markdown.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Parses a type definition, including nested properties.

methods.name: parseVariable
methods.description: Parses a variable, type, or argument declaration line.

methods.name: applyTemplates
methods.description: Applies markdown templates to the documentation body.

methods.name: extractComments
methods.description: Extracts comment nodes from a documentation node.

methods.name: parseApi
methods.description: Function to instantiate ApiParser and return the documentation object.

methods.name: extractMetainfo
methods.description: Extracts metadata such as since, deprecated, hidden, etc., from a documentation node.

methods.name: extractLangs
methods.description: Extracts language-specific info from documentation nodes.

methods.name: extractSince
methods.description: Extracts the 'since' version info from documentation nodes.

methods.name: extractHidden
methods.description: Checks if a node is marked as hidden.

methods.name: extractAttribute
methods.description: Extracts specific attribute values from documentation nodes.

methods.name: childrenWithoutProperties
methods.description: Filters out property-related nodes from children.

methods.name: isTypeOverride
methods.description: Determines if a member's type override is valid.

methods.name: checkNoDuplicateParamEntries
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate parameter entries in the markdown.
